title: Raman scattering on phonon-plasmon coupled modes in magnetic fields
abstract: Raman scattering on phonon--plasmon coupled modes in high magnetic fields is considered theoretically. The calculations of the dielectric function were performed in the long-wave approximation for the semiclassical and ultra-quantum magnetic fields taking into account the electron damping and intrinsic lifetime of optical phonons. The Raman scattering has resonances at the frequencies of coupled modes as well as at multiples of the cyclotron frequency. The dependence of the Raman cross section on the carrier concentration is analyzed.
